title: Checking out Scientology while setting up remote viewing

tellings.quote: oh year years years back i checked into it because at that time we were doing you know setting up a remote viewing program we were checking into everything silver mind control scientology whatever whatever i thought some of the techniques were definitely of value but i disconnected from them in their mid 70s

plain: In the early 1970s, while setting up a remote viewing programme, an effort to see whether people could describe distant places with the mind alone, the physicist Hal Puthoff says his team looked into "everything," including Silva Mind Control, a mental training course, and Scientology. He tells Michels this from his own part in it, saying some of the techniques "were definitely of value" but that he cut ties with Scientology in the mid 70s.
